zikrs.description: One who recites this 100 times a day will have 1,000 good deeds recorded and 1,000 sins wiped away.

zikrs.meaning: There is no god but Allah

zikrs.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللّٰه
zikrs.transliteration: La hawla wala quwwata illa billah
zikrs.meaning: There is no power except with Allah
zikrs.description: This is a treasure from the treasures of Paradise.

zikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ
zikrs.meaning: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace

zikrs.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِیکَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى کُلِّ شَیْءٍ قَدِیرٌ
zikrs.meaning: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah Alone

zikrs.arabic: اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ...
zikrs.meaning: Recite silently after every obligatory prayer
zikrs.description: Whoever recites this after every prayer, nothing but death prevents him from entering Paradise.

zikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
zikrs.meaning: O Allah, help me to remember You and thank You
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad
Allah is sufficient for me and the best guardian
Glory be to You O Allah, and Your praise
Our Lord, give us good in this world and the next
The Guide to the Right Path

zikrs.arabic: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَالِغُ أَمْرِهِ قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدْرًا
zikrs.transliteration: Wa man yattaqillaha yaj'al lahu makhrajaa. Wa yarzuqhu min haythu laa yahtasib. Wa man yatawakkal 'alallahi fahuwa hasbuh. Innallaha baalighu amrih. Qad ja'alallahu likulli shay'in qadraa.
zikrs.meaning: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out. And will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allah will accomplish His purpose. Allah has already set for everything a decreed extent.
Allah will be sufficient for you against them, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

zikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
zikrs.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi laa ilaaha illaa anta, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduka, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu, aboo'u laka bini'matika 'alayya, wa aboo'u laka bidhanbi faghfir li, fa innahu laa yaghfirudh-dhunooba illaa anta
zikrs.meaning: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I am upon Your covenant and promise as much as I am able. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your blessing upon me, and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for indeed none forgives sins except You.

zikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
zikrs.transliteration: Allahumma akfinee bihalaalika 'an haraamika wa aghnini bifadhlika 'amman siwaak
zikrs.meaning: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful, sparing me from what You have made unlawful, and enrich me by Your grace, making me free of need from all others besides You.
O Allah, grant me pure and lawful provision, and enable me to do righteous deeds.
O Allah, choose what is good for me and select the best for me.

zikrs.arabic: يَا اللَّهُ يَا رَحْمٰنُ يَا رَحِيمُ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ
zikrs.transliteration: Ya Allah, Ya Rahman, Ya Raheem, Ya Hayyu, Ya Qayyum
zikrs.meaning: O Allah, O Most Gracious, O Most Merciful, O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining.

zikrs.arabic: رَبِّ أَنْزِلْنِي مُنْزَلًا مُبَارَكًا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنْزِلِينَ
zikrs.transliteration: Rabbi anzilni munzalan mubaarakan wa anta khayrul munzileen
zikrs.meaning: My Lord, allow me a blessed landing, for You are the best of those who give landing.

zikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ مَغْفِرَتَكَ أَرْجَى مِنْ عَمَلِي
zikrs.meaning: O Allah, indeed Your forgiveness is more hoped for by me than my own deeds.

zikrs.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
zikrs.transliteration: Rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan wa hayyi' lana min amrina rashada
zikrs.meaning: Our Lord! Bestow on us mercy from Yourself, and prepare for us our affair in the right way.

zikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
zikrs.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka bi annaka antallahu la ilaha illa anta al-ahadus-samadu alladhi lam yalid wa lam yulad wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad
zikrs.meaning: O Allah, indeed I ask You, as You are Allah, there is none worthy of worship but You, the One, the As-Samad, the one who does not beget and was not begotten, and there is none who is equal to Him.

zikrs.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْنِي اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي
zikrs.transliteration: SubhanAllah, walhamdulillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu akbar, Allahummaghfir li, Allahumma arhamni, Allahumma urzuqni
zikrs.meaning: Glory be to Allah, and all praise be to Allah, and there is no deity but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, forgive me. O Allah, have mercy on me. O Allah, grant me sustenance.

zikrs.arabic: اللَّهُ لَطِيفٌ بِعِبَادِهِ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَاءُ وَهُوَ الْقَوِيُّ الْعَزِيزُ
zikrs.transliteration: Allahu lateefun bi'ibadihi yarzuqu man yasha'u wa huwal qawiyyul 'azeez
zikrs.meaning: Allah is Subtle with His servants; He gives provision to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.

zikrs.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
zikrs.transliteration: Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyumu bi rahmatika astaghithu aslih li sha'ni kullahu wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn
zikrs.meaning: O Ever-Living, O Self-Sustaining! By Your mercy I seek help. Rectify all my affairs and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.

zikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ، وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
zikrs.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal hammi wal hazani, wal 'ajzi wal kasali, wal bukhli wal jubni, wa dhala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal
zikrs.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from grief and sadness, from weakness and from laziness, from miserliness and from cowardice, from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men (i.e. others).

zikrs.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
zikrs.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadeer
zikrs.meaning: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is able to do all things.

zikrs.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ
zikrs.transliteration: SubhanAllahi walhamdulillahi wa la ilaha illallahu wallahu akbar wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billahil 'aliyyil 'azeem
zikrs.meaning: Glory be to Allah, and all praise to Allah, and there is no deity but Allah, and Allah is the Greatest. There is no power and no strength except with Allah, the Most High, the Most Great.

zikrs.transliteration: Allahumma salli salatan kamilatan wa sallim
zikrs.meaning: O Allah, send complete blessings and peace upon him.

zikrs.arabic: يَا غَنِيُّ يَا وَهَّابُ يَا رَزَّاقُ
zikrs.transliteration: Ya Ghaniyyu Ya Wahhabu Ya Razzaqu
zikrs.meaning: O Self-Sufficient, O Bestower, O Provider.

zikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ، وَالْقِلَّةِ، وَالذِّلَّةِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ
zikrs.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal faqri wal qillati wadh-dhillati, wa a'udhu bika min an azlima aw uzlam
zikrs.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from poverty, scarcity and humiliation, and I seek refuge in You from wronging others or being wronged.

zikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبَرَصِ وَالْجُنُونِ وَالْجُذَامِ وَمِنْ سَيِّئِ الْأَسْقَامِ
zikrs.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal barasi wal junooni wal judhami wa min sayyi'il asqam
zikrs.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from leucoderma, insanity, leprosy and from all evil diseases.

zikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ، وَاشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
zikrs.transliteration: Allahumma Rabban-nasi, adh-hibil ba'sa, washfi antash-shafi, la shifa'a illa shifa'uka, shifa'an la yughadiru saqama
zikrs.meaning: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the affliction and grant healing, for You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing, a healing that leaves no illness behind.

zikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
zikrs.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka ilman nafi'an wa rizqan tayyiban wa 'amalan mutaqabbala
zikrs.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, pure provision, and accepted deeds.

zikrs.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
zikrs.transliteration: Bismillahil ladhi la yadhurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwa as-sami'ul 'aleem
zikrs.meaning: In the name of Allah, with Whose name nothing can harm on earth or in heaven, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

zikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
zikrs.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa anta khalaqtani wa ana 'abduka wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu aboo'u laka bini'matika 'alayya wa aboo'u laka bidhanbi faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunooba illa anta
zikrs.meaning: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no deity but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide by Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil I have done. I acknowledge Your blessing upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.

zikrs.arabic: لَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ عَزِيزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ حَرِيصٌ عَلَيْكُم بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا فَقُلْ حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
zikrs.transliteration: Laqad ja'akum rasoolun min anfusikum 'azeezun 'alayhi ma 'anittum hareesun 'alaykum bil mu'mineena ra'oofur raheem, fa in tawallaw faqul hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huwa 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa rabbul 'arshil 'azeem
zikrs.meaning: There has certainly come to you a Messenger from among yourselves, grievous to him is what you suffer, and he is concerned over you, and to the believers he is kind and merciful. But if they turn away, say: Sufficient for me is Allah; there is no deity except Him. On Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.

zikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ
zikrs.transliteration: Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi'ilmika wa astaqdiruka biqudratika wa as'aluka min fadlikal 'azeem
zikrs.meaning: O Allah, I seek Your guidance through Your knowledge, and I seek Your power through Your power, and I ask You from Your great bounty.

zikrs.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَى نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
zikrs.transliteration: Subhanallahi wa bihamdihi 'adada khalqihi wa ridha nafsihi wa zinata 'arshihi wa midada kalimatihi
zikrs.meaning: Glory be to Allah and all praise to Him, as many times as the number of His creation, and as much as pleases Him, and as much as the weight of His Throne, and as much as the ink of His words.

zikrs.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
zikrs.transliteration: La ilaha illallahul 'azeemul haleem, la ilaha illallahu rabbul 'arshil 'azeem, la ilaha illallahu rabbus-samawati wa rabbul ardi wa rabbul 'arshil kareem
zikrs.meaning: There is no deity but Allah, the Magnificent, the Forbearing. There is no deity but Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. There is no deity but Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.

zikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فِعْلَ الْخَيْرَاتِ، وَتَرْكَ الْمُنْكَرَاتِ، وَحُبَّ الْمَسَاكِينِ، وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي وَتَرْحَمَنِي، وَإِذَا أَرَدْتَ فِتْنَةَ قَوْمٍ فَتَوَفَّنِي غَيْرَ مَفْتُونٍ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ حُبَّكَ، وَحُبَّ مَنْ يُحِبُّكَ، وَحُبَّ عَمَلٍ يُقَرِّبُنِي إِلَى حُبِّكَ
zikrs.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka fi'lal khayraat wa tarkal munkaraat wa hubbal masakeeni wa an taghfira li wa tarhamani wa idha aradta fitnata qawmin fatawaffani ghayra maftoonin wa as'aluka hubbaka wa hubba man yuhibbuka wa hubba 'amalin yuqarribuni ila hubbik
zikrs.meaning: O Allah, I ask You to grant me the performance of good deeds, abandonment of bad ones, and love of the poor; and I ask You that You forgive me and have mercy upon me; and if You intend to try a people, cause me to die without being tested; and I ask You for Your love, and the love of those who love You, and the love of actions which draw me closer to Your love.

zikrs.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ تَجَاوَزْ عَنْ آبَائِنَا وَأُمَّهَاتِنَا وَأَهْلِ دِينِنَا جَمِيعًا مَنْ سَلَفَ مِنْهُمْ وَمَنْ غَبَرَ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
zikrs.transliteration: Allahumma tajawaz 'an aba'ina wa ummahatiha wa ahli dinina jami'an man salafa minhum wa man ghbara ila yawmil qiyamah
zikrs.meaning: O Allah, forgive our fathers, our mothers, and all the people of our faith — those who have passed and those yet to come until the Day of Resurrection.
